scope: The agents' SQL runner (src/control/agent-sql.ts) against a disposable Supabase Postgres container on the workstation, connecting as an environment developer login created with the runtime's own SQL (lab/durable_runtime.py developer_sql and developer_grants_sql), directly rather than through the loopback listener. Produced by lab/agent-sql-check.ts. Not a server run and not a load test.
